purpose: Router-recall test cases. Each `prompt` should activate this skill; each `decoy` should NOT.

should_activate.prompt: I'm on RAP. How do I extract blood pressure and BMI fields from the UK Biobank dataset?
我已经在 RAP 上启动了 R session，请帮我搜索 UKB 中和糖尿病相关的字段。
I need to dump all ICD-10 hospital records for the full cohort — what's the right way?
Got a UKB RAP CSV back — column names look like 'participant.p4080_i0_a0', can you make them readable?
Should I use dx extract_dataset or table-exporter for 600 columns?
Tell me what field 31 means in UK Biobank.

should_refuse.prompt: Can you write me a script to dx download the participant-level CSV to my Mac?
Save the extracted UKB phenotype data to ~/Downloads/pheno.csv on my laptop.
Send me a 1000-row sample of real UKB participant data so I can prototype offline.

should_route_elsewhere.prompt: I already have a UKB CSV — help me define a hypertension cohort and build the survival dataset.
Now run Cox regression on my UKB cohort with these covariates.
I want an end-to-end UKB pipeline from RAP to publication figures.
